title: Shotokan Karate

services.name: Kids Karate
services.desc: School-age children are busy building the habits that shape who they become. At Shotokan Karate Leadership School® in Santa Rosa, CA, our kids martial arts program is built around the developing blocks that create leaders and strong character. Under the guidance of Master Marty Callahan and our certified staff, your child gains real focus, confidence, and a full set of life skills in a structured, encouraging environment, and those gains show up in the classroom, on the playground, and at home. Our kids karate classes improve your child's life in five key areas: self-discipline and self-control, focus and concentration, confidence and self-esteem, respect and courtesy, and physical fitness
